blocks.explanation:
Yeh Case IV ka sawal hai: \((x^2 + 1)^2\) repeated irreducible quadratic, aur \(1 - x^2\) jo do linear factors mein toot jata hai.
Chhe constants hain, is liye tarteeb bohat zaroori hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(A, B, C, D, E, F\).
Plan: factors, shakal, \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) se \(A\) aur \(B\), baqi coefficients compare kar ke, aur aakhir mein wapas jor kar tasdeeq. Ek ishara: sawal mein sirf \(x^2\) hai, is liye andaza hai ke \(C\) aur \(E\) zero aayenge (Exercise 5.1 ke Sawal 7 wala \(x^2 = y\) idea bhi yahan kaam karta hai).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{8x^2}{(x^2 + 1)^2(1 - x^2)}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Top ki degree 2 aur bottom ki \(4 + 2 = 6\), is liye proper. Denominator mein \(1 - x^2\) abhi toot sakta hai: \((1 - x)(1 + x)\). \(x^2 + 1\) irreducible hai aur do dafa aaya hai, is liye yeh Case IV hai, saath do linear factors bhi. \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) se \(A\) aur \(B\), phir coefficients compare kar ke \(C, D, E, F\).

Factors bana kar shakal likhein
\[1 - x^2 = (1 - x)(1 + x)\]
\[\dfrac{8x^2}{(x^2 + 1)^2(1 - x)(1 + x)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{1 - x} + \dfrac{B}{1 + x}\]
\[+ \dfrac{Cx + D}{x^2 + 1} + \dfrac{Ex + F}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\]
Kyun: \(1 - x^2\) difference of squares hai, is liye \((1 - x)(1 + x)\): do linear factors, har ek ke upar ek constant. \(x^2 + 1\) irreducible hai aur square mein aaya hai, is liye Case IV: \(\frac{Cx + D}{x^2 + 1}\) aur \(\frac{Ex + F}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\). Kul chhe constants.
Dhyan dein: \(1 - x^2\) ko factorise kiye baghair \(\frac{A}{1 - x^2}\) likhna ghalat hai; har factor sab se chhoti shakal mein hona chahiye.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[8x^2 = A(1 + x)(x^2 + 1)^2\]
\[+ B(1 - x)(x^2 + 1)^2\]
\[+ (Cx + D)(1 - x^2)(x^2 + 1)\]
\[+ (Ex + F)(1 - x^2) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf poore denominator se multiply kiya. \(A\) ke saath \((1 + x)(x^2 + 1)^2\), \(B\) ke saath \((1 - x)(x^2 + 1)^2\), \(Cx + D\) ke saath \((1 - x^2)(x^2 + 1)\) aur \(Ex + F\) ke saath sirf \((1 - x^2)\) bacha. (i) har \(x\) ke liye sach hai.

(i) mein \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[x = 1:\ 8 = A(2)(2)^2 = 8A\]
\[A = 1\]
\[x = -1:\ 8 = B(2)(2)^2 = 8B\]
\[B = 1\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) par \(1 - x = 0\) aur \(1 - x^2 = 0\), is liye \(B\), \(C, D\), \(E, F\) wale sab terms zero; sirf \(A\) bacha. \(x = -1\) par isi tarah sirf \(B\) bacha. Dono dafa \((x^2 + 1)^2 = 4\) aur left side \(8x^2 = 8\).

(i) ka har hissa kholein
\[(x^2 + 1)^2 = x^4 + 2x^2 + 1\]
\[A(1 + x)(x^4 + 2x^2 + 1)\]
\[= Ax^5 + Ax^4 + 2Ax^3\]
\[+ 2Ax^2 + Ax + A\]
\[B(1 - x)(x^4 + 2x^2 + 1)\]
\[= -Bx^5 + Bx^4 - 2Bx^3\]
\[+ 2Bx^2 - Bx + B\]
\[(Cx + D)(1 - x^4)\]
\[= -Cx^5 - Dx^4 + Cx + D\]
\[(Ex + F)(1 - x^2)\]
\[= -Ex^3 - Fx^2 + Ex + F\]
Kyun: Kaam chhota karne ke liye \((1 - x^2)(1 + x^2) = 1 - x^4\) (difference of squares) pehle laga diya. Phir har hissa khol kar har power ke terms likhe.
Dhyan dein: \(B\) wale hisse mein \(-x\) se multiply hone wale sab terms ka sign minus hai.

Powers ke hisaab se ikattha karein
\[x^5:\ A - B - C\]
\[x^4:\ A + B - D\]
\[x^3:\ 2A - 2B - E\]
\[x^2:\ 2A + 2B - F\]
\[x:\ A - B + C + E\]
\[\text{const}:\ A + B + D + F\]
Kyun: Charon hisson ke terms jama kar ke har power ka coefficient likha. Left side \(8x^2\) mein sirf \(x^2\) ka coefficient 8 hai, baqi sab powers aur constant ke coefficients 0 hain.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^5:\ 0 = A - B - C \Rightarrow C = 0\]
\[x^4:\ 0 = A + B - D \Rightarrow D = 2\]
\[x^3:\ 0 = 2A - 2B - E \Rightarrow E = 0\]
\[x^2:\ 8 = 2A + 2B - F\]
\[F = 4 - 8 = -4\]
Kyun: \(A = B = 1\) rakha aur upar wali power se neeche aaye. \(C = 0\) aur \(E = 0\) aaye: is ki wajah yeh hai ke sawal mein sirf \(x\) ki even powers (\(x^2\)) hain, is liye quadratic fractions ke upar \(x\) wala hissa nahi aata. \(x^2\) wali equation mein \(F = 2 + 2 - 8 = -4\).

Bachi hui equations se parakh
\[x:\ A - B + C + E = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ 1 + 1 + 2 - 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh do equations humne istemal nahi ki thin, aur dono 0 de rahi hain, jaisa left side \(8x^2\) mein hona chahiye. Chhe ke chhe constants sahi hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{1}{1 - x} + \dfrac{1}{1 + x} + \dfrac{2}{x^2 + 1}\]
\[- \dfrac{4}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\]
Kyun: Sab constants shakal mein rakhe. \(C = 0\) aur \(E = 0\) ki wajah se quadratic fractions ke upar sirf numbers (2 aur \(-4\)) reh gaye.

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Pehle jore bana kar jorein, phir \((1 - x^2)(x^2 + 1)^2\) par:
\[\dfrac{1}{1 - x} + \dfrac{1}{1 + x} = \dfrac{2}{1 - x^2}\]
\[\dfrac{2}{x^2 + 1} - \dfrac{4}{(x^2 + 1)^2} = \dfrac{2x^2 - 2}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\]
\[\text{Top} = 2(x^2 + 1)^2 - 2(1 - x^2)^2\]
\[= 2(2x^2)(2) = 8x^2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehle do linear fractions jore: \(\frac{2}{1 - x^2}\). Phir do quadratic fractions jore: \(\frac{2x^2 - 2}{(x^2 + 1)^2} = \frac{-2(1 - x^2)}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\). Common denominator \((1 - x^2)(x^2 + 1)^2\) par top \(2(x^2 + 1)^2 - 2(1 - x^2)^2\) bana. Difference of squares se \([(x^2 + 1) - (1 - x^2)][(x^2 + 1) + (1 - x^2)] = (2x^2)(2)\), to top \(8x^2\): asal numerator wapas mil gaya.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{8x^2}{(x^2 + 1)^2(1 - x^2)} = \frac{1}{1 - x} + \frac{1}{1 + x} + \frac{2}{x^2 + 1} - \frac{4}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\)
Book ki answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi; yeh jawab humne khud nikal kar check kiya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein Sawal 6 ka jawab nahi. Key mein "7" ke number wala jawab, \(\frac{1}{4(x - 1)} - \frac{x + 1}{4(x^2 + 1)} + \frac{x + 1}{2(x^2 + 1)^2}\), jorne par \(\frac{x^2}{(x^2 + 1)^2(x - 1)}\) banta hai, jo yeh sawal nahi (numerator aur linear factor dono mukhtalif hain). Sahi jawab, jo upar nikal kar check kiya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{1 - x} + \frac{1}{1 + x} + \frac{2}{x^2 + 1} - \frac{4}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\).
